messages:
anya: Quick sync — we have a joint marketplace listing with NorthBridge SI + EdgeHW. Need to confirm SOC2 evidence availability, pen-test window, questionnaire turnaround, and presign artifact window so marketing can lock the embargo. Who can own what?

Tom: I can own pen-test coordination with EdgeHW. Tentative timeline: gather vendor contacts + scope by Apr 5, run pen Apr 15-22. Will confirm availability.

jordan: I can take the questionnaire intake and redaction. Need a list of required docs from security + contact at the SI. Also prefer 48h presign links for partners to upload.

leah: For launch sequencing, compliance needs artifacts by Apr 12 to allow 48h redaction/QA. If pen finishes Apr 22, that squeezes marketing — can we move pen earlier?

Tom: I'll try to pull pen earlier but need partner sign-off. Also confirm: pen scope should include firmware and OTA components.

anya: Firmware attestation is a must. EdgeHW asked about HSM/KMS proof; we should capture attestation or an HSM config screenshot.

security-bot: FYI — standard upload prefix: s3://redwood-marketplace/evidence/<partner>/ ; presign default expiry = 48h. Use presign token prefix MARKETPLACE-PS-<partner>.

jordan: Noted. I'll create the questionnaire template and redaction checklist. Will ask partners for: SOC2 summary (or bridge), architecture diagram, firmware attestation, pen-scope statement, and contact list.

leah: On SOC2 — do we accept a summary/bridge + attestation instead of full report? Partners sometimes won't share full reports.

Tom: EdgeHW legal says they cannot share full SOC2 externally; they'll provide a SOC2 bridge + a scoped attestation letter from their external auditor. That should be acceptable for marketplace listing.

anya: OK — decision: accept SOC2 bridge + auditor attestation when full report is restricted. Document that as acceptable evidence.

jordan: Claire (SI contact) is claire@northbridge.com — I've looped her in via email. I'll upload the draft checklist here in channel in a few mins.

Tom: Action items for me: confirm pen vendor + scope includes firmware, request HSM attestation artifacts, and push pen earlier if feasible.

jordan: Action items: upload questionnaire template, create redaction checklist, generate presign links template. I'll also add a short guidance note for partners about attestation formats.

leah: Action items: align marketing embargo timeline with compliance; tentatively set comms hold until Apr 25 if pen stays Apr 15-22. If pen moves earlier, we'll update.

anya: I'll draft joint announcement stub and the compliance ask language to avoid back-and-forth. Will share by EOD.

jordan: Uploaded draft checklist: https://redwood-internal/share/marketplace-checklist-v1 (placeholder link) — feedback welcome.

Tom: Quick Q: do we need the full firmware image for pen or just hashes and signed attestations? That affects legal.

security-bot: Recommend hashes + signed attestation first. Full image only if pen vendor requests and partner signs extra NDA.

leah: Good call. Use hashed artifacts as default.

anya: Cool. Who wants to be the primary owner for the evidence presign window? I propose jordan as central intake owner.

jordan: I can be intake owner. I'll publish presign instructions and monitor uploads.

leah: All good from me. Please ping if dates slide.

Tom: Confirming owners: tom=pen coordination, jordan=evidence intake/redaction, leah=launch compliance, anya=comm lead. I'll start outreach to EdgeHW legal today.

anya: Thanks team — let's reconvene Thu if we have Claire's answers. :thumbsup:
